weather.title: Set up Assist Weather
weather.description: Choose the Home Assistant weather entity that Assist Weather should query. Enable Assist Weather in your existing LLM conversation agent.

user.title: Choose Assist Tools setup
user.description: Configure a satellite timer or weather provider.

satellite.title: Connect an Assist satellite
satellite.description: Choose the originating satellite. A unique available media player with the same display name is selected automatically. Otherwise you can select a player in the next step. Enable Assist Timer in your existing LLM conversation agent.

player.title: Select an alarm media player
player.description: No unique usable player with the satellite's display name was found. Select the player that should sound this satellite's alarm.

reconfigure.title: Update satellite settings
reconfigure.description: Cancel any active timer before updating the media player. To change the satellite device, remove this entry and add a new one.

error.play_stop_not_supported: The media player must support playback and stop.
error.satellite_no_device: The satellite must belong to a registered device.
error.satellite_already_configured: This satellite device is already configured.
error.player_already_configured: This media player already belongs to another satellite timer.
error.cannot_change_satellite: The satellite device cannot be changed in this entry.
error.cancel_timer_before_reconfigure: Cancel the existing timer before reconfiguring.

abort.unsupported_entry: This legacy entry is no longer supported. Remove it from Devices & services.
